title: Body of missing Pakistani climber Sohail Sakhi recovered on Broad Peak

article.title: Body of missing Pakistani climber Sohail Sakhi recovered on Broad Peak
article.summary: The body of Pakistani climber Sohail Sakhi, who was among the 10-person expedition that went missing after the deadly Broad Peak avalanche , was recovered and shifted to the mountain’s base camp, the Alpine Club of Pakistan (ACP) said on Thursday. The avalanche struck on July 30, cutting off contact with the 10-member international expedition led by world-renowned British-Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains. Purja’s company later confirmed there were no survivors . The bodies of seven climbers were found. However, the search for Sakhi, American climber Sarah Mallory Geis, and Nepalese climber Nawang Thindu Sherpa was suspended last week due to a risk of fresh avalanches. On Thursday, ACP member Naila Kiani said that Sakhi’s body had been found. According to Naila, a team of local volunteers from Shigar, searching the area on their own initiative, found the remains, which were subsequently confirmed as those of Sakhi. She said the volunteers — Muhammad Nadeem, Muhammad Bashir and Abuzar — first spotted the body and alerted others in the area. They, along with other volunteers, brought the body down from Camp 1 to the base camp. ACP Gen
